def solve_n_queens(n):
    """Solve N-Queens using backtracking."""
    solutions = []
    cols = set()
    diag1 = set()  # row - col
    diag2 = set()  # row + col
    placement = []

    def backtrack(row):
        if row == n:
            solutions.append(placement[:])
            return True  # Return first solution only
        for col in range(n):
            if col in cols or (row - col) in diag1 or (row + col) in diag2:
                continue
            cols.add(col)
            diag1.add(row - col)
            diag2.add(row + col)
            placement.append(col)
            if backtrack(row + 1):
                return True
            placement.pop()
            cols.remove(col)
            diag1.remove(row - col)
            diag2.remove(row + col)
        return False

    backtrack(0)
    return solutions[0] if solutions else None

solution = solve_n_queens(11)

def verify(sol):
    n = len(sol)
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(i+1, n):
            assert sol[i] != sol[j], f"Column conflict: rows {i},{j}"
            assert abs(sol[i] - sol[j]) != abs(i - j), f"Diagonal conflict: rows {i},{j}"
    print("✓ Verified: No two queens attack each other!")

verify(solution)
